{{Quote|The way Beachcombers smuggle things into the area is to have them air-dropped into the sea. They then pick up the crates of goods as they wash up on shore.|[[Jonni Skaak|Jonthol Mazoon]]|<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" />}}
The '''Beachcombers''' were a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] active on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were particularly active on the beaches around the city of [[Kaadara]]. During his career in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], [[Jonni Skaak|Jonthol Mazoon]] arrested several Beachcombers, including their leader [[Phranis Bolgar]]. At some point after the [[Raid on the Skaak Tipper Hideout|death]] of Jonthol Mazoon, a spacer killed another Beachcomber leader, [[Lonnley Bolgar]].<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Beachcombers appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TLaDoJS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Beachcombers were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
